$about: Design decisions that depart from a rule on purpose, so nobody 'fixes' them by accident and everyone can see them (and reconsider them). Read by build/audit.mjs: an exception with an 'audit' entry is not reported as a failure, but it is measured and printed under 'Kept as designed' on every run, with the value of that run.
kind: exception = it fails a check (contrast, …) and is kept; decision = a deliberate choice the system's general rule does not make by itself.

audit.axe: the axe rule and the elements it may fail on (a regular expression on the target). audit.pixels: which texts drawn over a canvas this exception covers. The audit finds every text over a canvas by itself (axe cannot see a canvas) and measures it from the pixels behind it; one that fails and is not covered here is a failure.

decisions.what: CTA card: the white title, the white text and the focus ring of the white button sit on the light purple between the dots (#b596ff, STIPPLE_CTA.background in scripts/stipple.js)
decisions.rule: WCAG 1.4.3 text contrast (3 : 1 large, 4.5 : 1 text), 1.4.11 focus indicator 3 : 1
decisions.why: the look of the card: purple dots on a lighter purple
decisions.fix: swap the two colours of the dots (purple between them: white text 4.61 : 1), or a darker middle; the focus ring can be ink on this card (8.8 : 1)

decisions.what: White text on the colours of the card stack and the stats: the orange «Документы» and green «Финансы» cards, their labels (also over the progress fill), the orange, green and blue stats
decisions.rule: WCAG 1.4.3 text contrast: the labels are 500, not bold, so they need 4.5 : 1
decisions.measured: labels on orange 2.95 (over the fill 2.17), on green 3.76 (2.52); stat labels 2.8 (orange) – 3.6 (green); stat numbers 2.3 (orange) – 2.8 (green) on the dots (Oct 17, 2026)
decisions.why: the brand colours of the subjects
decisions.fix: text-safe shades for text-bearing surfaces: orange #c25700, green #008a25 (4.5 : 1)

decisions.what: White text on the teal (Telegram-бот) and orange (FM Lens demo) buttons
decisions.why: the brand colours of the two tools

decisions.what: The grey notes of the footer (ink 40% on the footer grey)
Tool cards are padded one ladder step above their radius (--pad-l: 40 → 64px with radius/l 32 → 56px); every other card is padded by its radius
decisions.why: extra air: a big two-column card with a picture

decisions.what: Where two lines of the hero title do not fit (about under 430px), it takes three: «Весь лейбл. / На одной / волне». Chosen by fit (a container query in the title's em), not by a screen width
decisions.why: keeps the hero a scale step above the section headings on phones (37 vs 31px at 320, instead of 29 vs 28)

decisions.what: The logo strip shows whole columns (2, 3, 4, chosen by its own width). Adding a column makes the tiles smaller at once (−33% from 2 to 3, −25% from 3 to 4); the steps are placed where the tiles stay big enough after the drop (≥ 128 and ≥ 160px)
decisions.why: whole columns preferred over a fluid tile with a partly shown column

decisions.what: The ID cards are an object of a fixed size (240 × 345px), scaled as a whole by the row or the deck; only their corners follow the screen (the tile radius, the table half a radius in)
decisions.why: their text stays readable at one size; the corners match the tiles around them

decisions.what: Running text is 16px at every screen width (type/body = 1rem; the scale's base)
